question: Am I still on time to file my annual income tax return today?
apiAnswer:
### Short Answer
TINA cannot confirm whether you are still on time to file without the taxable year, return type and operative deadline.

### What TINA needs to confirm your deadline
Please confirm your taxable year, the return type, and any relevant BIR extension or special deadline notice so the operative deadline can be determined.
